name: 78L05
description: Small 100mA fixed positive regulator in TO-92, the low-current cousin of the 7805. The 78L05 is 5V, 78L12 is 12V, etc. Critically, the TO-92 pinout is OUT-GND-IN, which is NOT the same as the TO-220 7805 (IN-GND-OUT).

TO-92.notes: TO-92, flat face toward you, leads down: OUT-GND-IN. Opposite of the 7805 TO-220 order.

extra.Vin_max: 30V operating; 35V abs max (legacy chip), 45V abs max (new chip)

typical_application: Local low-current rails for op-amps and logic where a full 7805 is overkill. Add 0.33uF in and 0.1uF out near the pins.
gotchas: TO-92 pinout is OUT-GND-IN, the REVERSE of the TO-220 7805; swapping them wrong destroys the part
only 100mA; use a 7805 for heavier loads
needs input/output caps to stay stable
